'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Michael Gemme DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Gemme]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet Gonne → Gemme. Phantom Menace struck on sheet but kept for 60.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Gemme]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
